_provenance: Honest snapshot of what data actually feeds this app and how - not a live connector registry with health polling. Recorded 2026-08-26.

sources.name: PubMed / PMC
sources.contributes: 12 peer-reviewed papers - PMID/PMCID/DOI/title/authors/journal/year read back from the live NCBI-backed API this session.

sources.name: Crossref
sources.contributes: Would provide DOI resolution / metadata cross-check.

sources.name: Semantic Scholar
sources.contributes: Would provide citation graph / related-work discovery.

sources.name: Google Scholar
sources.contributes: No official bulk API exists - used only as a manual cross-check link, never scraped.

sources.name: Google Trends
sources.contributes: Would provide search-interest data (not sales/demand/WTP even if connected).

sources.name: CBS (Statistics Netherlands)
sources.contributes: Mean disposable household income, mean equivalised income, private household count, energy bill anchor.
sources.method: web search + direct page fetch (not the CBS OData API)

sources.name: Eurostat
sources.contributes: Dutch household electricity price (2,500-5,000 kWh band), via a Statista-hosted Eurostat figure.

sources.name: APPLiA Nederland
sources.contributes: Dutch appliance-market turnover and unit-volume figures for 2024/2025, SDA premiumisation.

sources.name: Versuni / Philips official
sources.contributes: 7 of ~20 candidate SKUs verified with real spec + real downloaded/hashed official image (PureProtect 3200 AC3220/10, PureProtect Mini 900 AC0950/10, PureProtect Pro 4200 AC4220/12, 800i AC0850/41, 1000i AC1715/10, PureProtect Quiet 2200 AC2220/10, Air Performer 7000 AMF765/70). The rest of the candidate SKU list is NOT yet verified - shown as UNKNOWN, not inferred.
